§ 1. A covered entity shall, following the discovery of a breach of unsecured
protected health information, notify each individual whose unsecured protected
health information has been, or is reasonably believed by the covered entity to
have been, accessed, acquired, used, or disclosed as a result of such breach.

§ 2. Except as provided in § 164.412, a covered entity shall provide the
notification required by paragraph (a) of this section without unreasonable
delay and in no case later than 60 calendar days after discovery of a breach.
